lines.en: I float over snow without a print.
The heavy armor sways on me.
The canister knocks lightly at my hip.
I don't land; I drift over.
The snowfield wind passes through me.
I close in slowly on your direction.
My footprints simply stop.
There's nothing under the plates.
I slide along, dragging my shadow.
Light passes through my shoulder.
I drift around a dead tree.
Every step is silent.
I hang still in the wind and snow.
Thin mist seeps from my armor's seams.
The canister at my hip still ticks.
I wait for the moment of being hurt.
Snow vanishes as it touches my plates.
There are no lungs in this armor.
I raise a hand and see it's translucent.
Someone is walking out there.
My eyes glow harshly.
The wind rocks me slightly.
You look at me like a suit of armor.
My eyes never stop glowing.
Not afraid of me? Good.
I stand five steps off, still.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气我看见了。
lines.en: I see the white mist of your breath.
I can see the snow behind you.
Do you mean to strike first?
I don't need to strike first.
Your breath hangs in the mist.
I tilt my helm.
My breastplate took a dent.
I retreat, and the mist thins.
A crack has opened in me.
That blow made me more solid.
You touched my armor.
I tilt my head, expressionless.
I press a hand to my chest.
Wind through the crack feels cold.
I remain where I stood.
I'm not angry — I just remember.
I can't eat anything.
Holding that up is wasted effort.
I only want your life's warmth.
That warmth is drifting toward me.
Come a little closer my way.
I don't rely on handouts.
Set the thing down.
It isn't that which draws me.
Your fingertips shake faster than the wind.
Your heartbeat grows louder.
You passed halfway through me.
My plate numbed your hand.
I neither retreat nor advance.
You hit me like hitting cold air.
The canister clatters from the bump.
Don't come up against me.
I tilted slightly toward you.
Our shadows overlap.

lines.zh: 你的手从我肩里抽出来。
lines.en: Your hand pulls out of my shoulder.
That one doesn't count.
I don't have that kind of body.
There's only wind inside the armor.
Neither of us gives off warmth.
We stand together, watching each other.
Our kind are few, and not close.
We can fight without standing close.
You'll fade, and so will I.
We'll just drift side by side.
I'll watch the snow behind you.
Don't speak; save your breath.
This plate is of use to me.
I lift it; it has no weight.
Your thing fell on the ground.
I drop it into the canister.
This ore is bright.
I can't hold it long.
It slipped through my fingers.
It has no warmth in my hand.
I set it on the snow.
Consider it accepted.
I see you at last.
You've stepped into this snow.
The canister is warming up.

lines.zh: 我不会给你喘气的时间。
lines.en: I will not give you time to breathe.
I see your warmth.
You won't make it up this slope.
My eyes are locked on you.

lines.zh: 你是这片雪原上唯一活着的。
lines.en: You're the only living thing on this snow.
I haven't moved in a long while.
Begin — I won't hold back.
I lean toward you.
The wind's died — just as I like.
Do you hear the clatter of plates?
I'm heading your way now.
You had better not run.
I drift at your left.
There are no prints of mine in the snow.
Only half a step remains between us.
My hand has reached out.
Look back and there's nothing.
The plates rasp very quietly.
Snow has closed your retreat.
Three paces behind you, my armor creaks.
What's in the canister has woken.
Your warmth grows shorter by the step.
The snow is up to your knees.
I want you to turn around.
There's only us here.
One more step and you fall.
The wind scatters my shape.
The scattered mist gathers again.
Very close now.
The armor falls silent; now.
An armored arm sweeps through you.
The cold throws you back half a step.
My hand passes into your sleeve.
The canister strikes you.
My fist has no weight.

lines.zh: 那一击却让你喘不上气。
lines.en: That blow still knocks your breath out.
You can't get a grip on me at all.
I raise a hand and stop your blade.
You're shoved into the snow.
The plates rattle by your ear.
I press close — cold, isn't it?
Your fingers have gone stiff.

lines.zh: 我的手套攥住你的衣领。
lines.en: My gauntlet closes on your collar.
You've taken another blow.
I release; you pull away.
This isn't nearly over.
I rise out of the snow.
My armor gleams white in the moonlight.
The canister ticks softly at my hip.
This snowfield is empty.
I lower my helm.
Snow settles layer by layer on my shoulders.
I open my eyes; the glow is harsh.
There's a campfire far off.
I drift slowly upward.
There's no other scent on the wind.
First I move a finger.
Which way should I go?
The warmth across the snow has shifted.
I begin drifting forward.
The firelight pushed me back.
The plates scattered as I fell.
Water scatters me about.
The blast thins me out.
The arrow passes through and sticks in snow.
That light tears my shape open.
I've been empty a long while.
The lightning lit up all my plates.
Blankness below; I'm falling.
